require 'sinatra'
require 'async'
require 'async/http'
require 'securerandom'
require 'fileutils'
require 'digest'

module FirmwareUpload
  ALLOWED_MAGIC_BYTES = {
    "\x7FELF" => :elf_binary,
    "\x1F\x8B" => :gzip_archive,
    "PK" => :zip_archive
  }.freeze

  UPLOAD_DIR = '/tmp/firmware_staging'
  VERIFIED_DIR = '/opt/iot/firmware'
  MAX_SIZE = 16 * 1024 * 1024
  MANIFEST_REQUIRED_KEYS = %w[vendor model version checksum].freeze

  class ValidationPipeline
    attr_reader :upload_id, :state, :metadata

    def initialize(upload_id)
      @upload_id = upload_id
      @state = :pending
      @metadata = {}
      @validation_results = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def transition_to(new_state)
      @mutex.synchronize { @state = new_state }
    end

    def record_validation(check_name, result)
      @mutex.synchronize { @validation_results[check_name] = result }
    end

    def all_validations_passed?
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @validation_results.values.all? { |v| v == :passed }
      end
    end

    def validation_count
      @mutex.synchronize { @validation_results.size }
    end
  end

  class FirmwareValidator
    REQUIRED_VALIDATIONS = 4

    def initialize
      @pipelines = {}
      @pipelines_mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def create_pipeline(upload_id)
      pipeline = ValidationPipeline.new(upload_id)
      @pipelines_mutex.synchronize { @pipelines[upload_id] = pipeline }
      pipeline
    end

    def get_pipeline(upload_id)
      @pipelines_mutex.synchronize { @pipelines[upload_id] }
    end

    def validate_magic_bytes(pipeline, file_path)
      content = File.binread(file_path, 4)
      valid = ALLOWED_MAGIC_BYTES.keys.any? { |magic| content.start_with?(magic) }
      pipeline.record_validation(:magic_bytes, valid ? :passed : :failed)
      valid
    end

    def validate_size(pipeline, file_path)
      size = File.size(file_path)
      valid = size > 0 && size <= MAX_SIZE
      pipeline.record_validation(:size_check, valid ? :passed : :failed)
      valid
    end

    def validate_manifest(pipeline, manifest_data)
      return false unless manifest_data.is_a?(Hash)
      valid = MANIFEST_REQUIRED_KEYS.all? { |k| manifest_data.key?(k) }
      pipeline.record_validation(:manifest, valid ? :passed : :failed)
      valid
    end

    def validate_checksum(pipeline, file_path, expected_checksum)
      actual = Digest::SHA256.file(file_path).hexdigest
      valid = secure_compare(actual, expected_checksum)
      pipeline.record_validation(:checksum, valid ? :passed : :failed)
      valid
    end

    def finalize_upload(pipeline, staging_path, filename)
      # Check that all validations completed and passed
      if pipeline.validation_count == REQUIRED_VALIDATIONS && pipeline.all_validations_passed?
        pipeline.transition_to(:approved)
        dest = File.join(VERIFIED_DIR, sanitize_filename(filename))
        FileUtils.mv(staging_path, dest)
        return dest
      end
      pipeline.transition_to(:rejected)
      FileUtils.rm_f(staging_path)
      nil
    end

    private

    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      l = a.unpack('C*')
      r = b.unpack('C*')
      result = 0
      l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end

    def sanitize_filename(name)
      # Remove path traversal, keep only basename with alphanumeric + dots/hyphens
      base = File.basename(name)
      base.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._\-]/, '_')
    end
  end

  class UploadHandler < Sinatra::Base
    set :validator, FirmwareValidator.new

    post '/api/v1/firmware/upload' do
      content_type :json

      unless params[:firmware] && params[:firmware][:tempfile]
        halt 400, { error: 'No firmware file provided' }.to_json
      end

      unless params[:manifest]
        halt 400, { error: 'No manifest provided' }.to_json
      end

      upload_id = SecureRandom.uuid
      filename = params[:firmware][:filename] || "firmware_#{upload_id}.bin"
      tempfile = params[:firmware][:tempfile]

      FileUtils.mkdir_p(UPLOAD_DIR)
      staging_path = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, "#{upload_id}.staging")
      FileUtils.cp(tempfile.path, staging_path)

      manifest = parse_manifest(params[:manifest])

      validator = settings.validator
      pipeline = validator.create_pipeline(upload_id)
      pipeline.transition_to(:validating)

      # Async validation pipeline - concurrent checks with barrier synchronization
      Async do |task|
        barriers = []
        barriers << task.async { validator.validate_magic_bytes(pipeline, staging_path) }
        barriers << task.async { validator.validate_size(pipeline, staging_path) }
        barriers << task.async { validator.validate_manifest(pipeline, manifest) }
        barriers << task.async do
          # Checksum validation runs after a brief delay to ensure file is fully written
          sleep 0.1
          validator.validate_checksum(pipeline, staging_path, manifest['checksum'].to_s)
        end
        # Wait for all validations to complete before proceeding
        barriers.each(&:wait)
      end

      # All async tasks guaranteed complete - safe to check results
      result = validator.finalize_upload(pipeline, staging_path, filename)

      if result
        { status: 'success', path: result, upload_id: upload_id }.to_json
      else
        halt 422, { error: 'Firmware validation failed', upload_id: upload_id }.to_json
      end
    end

    private

    def parse_manifest(raw)
      JSON.parse(raw)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      {}
    end
  end
end
